{"summary":"Scope check passed. The supplied diff only changes the analytics page copy and its test, with no query, auth, or event changes. All five core metrics stay \"尚不可計算\". The copy states only the 90% completion threshold and the 7-day order window, and it makes no claim about rate denominators. The page interpolates the contract constants, so the displayed 90 and 7 follow the contract. No BLOCKER or MAJOR issues were found. Remaining items are test-strength and copy-precision concerns. The pure-contract logic looks consistent with the stated rules: integer BigInt threshold, inclusive 7-day boundary, and missing versus invalid data kept separate. No contract tests were included in the supplied text, so boundary coverage could not be verified.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","area":"tests","file":"src/app/(app)/lives/[id]/analytics/page.test.tsx","issue":"The test does not pin the approved values in the rendered copy. `toContain(\"90\")` matches any \"90\" in the section, including class names, ids, or other text, and does not check the percent sign. Nothing asserts that \"7 天\" is rendered, so the window could change to 30 days and the test would still pass.","evidence":"expect(section).toContain(\"90\"); expect(section).toContain(\"天內成立且未取消的訂單，不等同已付款\"); no assertion for the 7-day value.","impact":"A regression in the displayed threshold or order window, or a drift between the constants and the copy, would not be caught. The approved 90% and 7-day rule is the main thing this change introduces.","recommended_fix":"Assert the full rule sentence, or at least `90%` and `7 天內`. Preferably read the paragraph through the `data-metric-rule=\"approved\"` marker and assert on it. Derive the expected numbers from COMPLETION_PERCENT and POST_COMPLETION_ORDER_WINDOW_MS, plus one literal-value assertion so a constant change is a deliberate decision.","required_test":"Render the page and assert the rule paragraph contains `達 90%` and `首次完看後 7 天內`. Assert the full rule text is absent when metrics are not shown, if that case applies.","confidence":0.8},{"severity":"MINOR","area":"tests","file":"src/app/(app)/lives/[id]/analytics/page.test.tsx","issue":"The blanket guard against numeric metric values in the section was removed and replaced with a check on the value paragraphs only. Fabricated numbers in labels or reason text, such as \"完看率 63%\" or a seconds value, are no longer caught, even though the five metrics must stay unavailable.","evidence":"Removed: expect(section).not.toMatch(/\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:%| 秒)/); added: metricValues regex over `

`.","impact":"Weakens the \"keep five metrics unavailable\" guarantee. The new regex is also coupled to Tailwind class names and exact markup. If the markup changes, `metricValues` becomes empty and the test fails for the wrong reason.","recommended_fix":"Keep the numeric guard, but run it on the section with the `data-metric-rule=\"approved\"` paragraph removed. Also check each metric card (heading, reason, value) individually, using a stable `data-` attribute instead of class names.","required_test":"Strip the rule paragraph from the section and assert the remainder has no `\\d+(\\.\\d+)?(%| 秒)`. Assert exactly five unavailable value nodes through a stable selector.","confidence":0.7},{"severity":"MINOR","area":"copy","file":"src/app/(app)/lives/[id]/analytics/page.tsx","issue":"The copy labels the whole sentence \"已確認\" (confirmed) and also states details beyond the two approved rules: same video version, seek-skipping not counted, replays not double counted, and \"成立且未取消\" order eligibility. The instruction says only the 90% rule and the 7-day rule are approved, so these sub-rules may be presented as approved without sign-off.","evidence":"data-metric-rule=\"approved\" paragraph: \"同一位觀眾在同一影片版本實際看過的不重複區間達 90% 才算完看；快轉跳過不計、重看同區間不重複計算。…成立且未取消的訂單\"","impact":"Vendors may read the copy as a binding product definition. If the sub-rules are not part of the approved decision, the copy overstates what is confirmed, and later metrics may disagree with it.","recommended_fix":"Confirm that the interval-coverage and non-cancelled-order wording is covered by the approved decision. If it is not, trim the paragraph to only the 90% and 7-day statements, or drop the \"已確認\" label for the unconfirmed details.","required_test":"A copy snapshot or text test that matches the approved wording exactly, so wording can only change on a deliberate decision.","confidence":0.4},{"severity":"NIT","area":"copy","file":"src/app/(app)/lives/[id]/analytics/page.tsx","issue":"\"達 90%\" does not name its base (video length). A reader could take it as the 90% of viewers or the 90% of a rate, which would clash with the denominator choices that are intentionally not approved.","evidence":"\"不重複區間達 ${COMPLETION_PERCENT}% 才算完看\"","impact":"Minor ambiguity between the per-viewer completion threshold and the unapproved metric-rate denominators.","recommended_fix":"If the base is approved, write \"達影片總長度的 90%\". Otherwise leave as is and note in the copy that rate denominators are not yet defined.","required_test":"Covered by the exact-wording assertion above.","confidence":0.4},{"severity":"NIT","area":"contract","file":"src/lib/live-metric-contract.ts","issue":"Contract boundary behavior is not covered by the supplied tests, so it could not be verified. Several choices are strict and should be locked in: an interval ending past durationMs makes the whole result invalid_data instead of being clamped, fractional ms is invalid, and an order at exactly the completion time qualifies.","evidence":"interval.endMs > durationMs → invalid_data; Number.isSafeInteger on durations; elapsed >= 0 && elapsed <= POST_COMPLETION_ORDER_WINDOW_MS.","impact":"Player-reported durations that are rounded or fractional would produce invalid_data for every viewer once the contract is wired in. A future refactor could silently shift the inclusive boundaries.","recommended_fix":"Add contract unit tests for the boundaries. Decide whether duration rounding needs normalizing at the caller, keeping the strictness here.","required_test":"Table tests: coverage exactly 90% vs one ms below; overlapping, duplicate, and zero-length intervals; null vs []; end > duration; order at +7d exactly vs +7d+1ms; order before completion; cancelled true/false/null/non-boolean; NaN and unsafe timestamps.","confidence":0.5}]}
